title: AEIB v0.4.1: Benchmark Specifications and Regulatory Evidence Artifacts
description:
Technical specifications, threat models, 14 named verification properties, regulatory evidence mappings (EU DORA RTS 2024/1772 & ITS 2024/2956, ISO 42001), SCITT-aligned evidence schemas, and independent clean-room reproduction guidelines for the Agent Evidence Interlock Boundary (AEIB v0.4.1).

License: CC-BY-4.0. Executable source code and test harnesses are deposited under Apache-2.0 in the companion deposition record.
notes: Evidence artifacts represent tested outputs within configured evaluation scenarios. SCITT alignment represents an evidence format mapping; transparency service registration requires external infrastructure.
